GOOD QUESTIONS. CLEAR ANSWERS.

Let's make
the picture clearer.

Ask the SAFORA team →
What is SAFORA?+

SAFORA is a cybersecurity command center that brings exposure, identity, cloud security, control validation and organizational risk into a shared workspace. Teams can move from a posture summary into the findings and evidence behind it.

Who is the platform designed for?+

Security operations, cloud and identity teams, and security leaders who need a consistent perspective on their environment. A walkthrough can focus on the workflows most relevant to your team.

Does this preview use live security data?+

No. The interactive explorer uses illustrative demo data. The current product uses seeded integration data; discuss production data connections and remediation integrations with the team for your environment.

How can we see the platform in action?+

Email support@safora.ai to request a guided demo. Tell us about your environment and priorities so we can focus the conversation.
